name: token-cost-guard
summary: Realtime agent token cost monitor with threshold-based alert reports.
description: Monitor OpenClaw or Hermes agent token usage from the active runtime's own records, price DeepSeek/Kimi/GPT model calls, compare current cost against the previous snapshot, and generate or send an alert when spend exceeds a configured threshold.

scripts.description: Stdlib-only CLI for computing OpenClaw token costs and alerting on cost deltas.

author: harrylabsj
